listing.name: Cardinal Mode
listing.summary: A very lightweight mod that simply exposes the setting "CardinalMode", which, when set to true, enables you to move your ship according to absolute direction rather than relative facing.
listing.aiSummary: Enables absolute directional movement for ships instead of relative facing.

description: Exposes a hidden setting called CardinalMode. When enabled, ship movement is based on absolute directions rather than the ship's current orientation. Note that this overrides turn keys, requiring shift-aiming to rotate the ship.
